vc_shape.pre_pure: getPtr removed = node; nodes = prefix ++ removed :: suffix
vc_shape.post_spatial: shifted prefix; prev.next = node; node.next = next; node.prev = prev; next.prev = node; reverse-shifted suffix; removed payload

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose next and prev exposed by splitting the dllseg and unfolding the removed cons. Either identical disjunct can be proved.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold store_dll, split at prefix, unfold the removed node, convert prefix/suffix into shifted segments using the two sentinel link fields, and frame payload.
witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite nodes using decomposition and replace the split midpoint by node using getPtr removed = node.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No monadic refinement; direct separation-logic contract.
premise_discharge: The precondition supplies the exact list split.
store_dll supplies both sentinel fields required by shift conversion.
Unfolding the removed cons supplies both node fields and payload.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Same DoubleLinkListRmNode contract and DLL segment helper family; five related witnesses fit the bound of twelve.

vc_shape.post_spatial: store_dll head (prefix ++ suffix); store_dll node nil; identical removed payload
vc_shape.post_exists: first/last endpoints hidden in rebuilt store_dll

witnesses.pure_plan: No extra nonzero or alias guard is needed: the current CanonicalDLL lemmas consume precisely the supplied resources.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No monadic refinement; direct separation-logic contract.
premise_discharge: Self-link stores discharge the empty-list lemma premises.
Updated prev.next and next.prev discharge shift-conversion premises.
Converted segments share next/prev boundaries for concatenation.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Same DoubleLinkListRmNode contract and DLL segment helper family; five related witnesses fit the bound of twelve.

witnesses.space_plan: Allocate no new heap: cancel the strong precondition and introduce the wand, whose heap postconditions coincide after app_nil_r.

vc_shape.post_pure: removed pointer equality; xizi_dll_remove_node_rel removed nodes remaining

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Use first_split__storeA_remove on pointer membership to obtain prefix, removed, suffix. Set remaining = prefix ++ suffix.
witnesses.space_plan: The original DLL resource satisfies the instantiated strong precondition; under its postcondition, keep the exact three spatial resources and introduce member-spec existential witnesses.

The helper decomposition constructs the relational prefix/suffix existential.
